observations: Permission-specific standard_access true establishes BASIC access for people with an app role; advanced_access false does not establish public access.
Aggregate privilege rejection/not-live fields coexist with role access. Do not infer lack of developer-role access from the aggregate row.
History has no submissions, while earlier status and requirements responses disagree. These records do not prove a pending or completed Instant Games product review.
No permissions, app settings, submissions, uploads, Firebase configuration or services were changed by these read-only queries.
